authority: Supplemental artwork/page-composition interpretation of user-provided pictures. Never changes the canonical 15-skin ID list or behavioral contract.

referenceStorage.sourceImportGate: Place user-supplied originals in review-only repo path with recorded checksum and explicit permission; no false public URL in contract; future screenshots require exact reference evidence.
referenceStorage.hashMethod: SHA-256 of original user-supplied PNG bytes as received on 2026-10-26

photos.role: administrative application shell and illustrated dashboard
photos.layout: Permanent left rail with raw painted active stroke; thin top header; massive mixed-type hero; cyber-city moon illustration right; graphic workflow center; tight comic-bordered operation panels, statuses and miniature project cards
photos.avoid: Do not bake the entire screenshot into the dashboard background; labels, statuses, data and actions must be DOM content.

photos.layout: Hand-painted visual masthead on neon moon city and manga imagery; layered collage tape/stickers; editorial story tiles; contact-sheet timeline; crew-map rail; irregular but intentional column rhythm
photos.avoid: Public landing can be more expressive than dense admin; do not use rasterized entire page as UI.

photos.role: editorial campaign artwork, NOT standard admin form or shell
photos.layout: Tall portrait full-bleed stage illustration; layered performer silhouettes, crowns, scratches, torn handwritten caption stickers, sound/energy burst and high-impact diagonal overprints; meaningful copy remains text when published as accessible webpage
photos.avoid: Never turn dense data tables, authentication fields or semantic buttons into all-over poster layers; do not copy copyrighted lyrics or licensed artist likeness into reusable asset pack.

photos.role: sign-in screen with strong framed brand world and legible accessible form
photos.layout: About half left for branded intro and semantic username/password form in gritty framed dark panel; about half right for original night-city blue moon and hooded character artwork; brand scratches isolated to margins; clear neon-pink CTA
photos.avoid: Do not put text fields into image, do not fake auth result, do not crop the form on narrow screens.

creativeNorthStar: Cinematic Manga-Punk Neo-Brutalism — original ink, graffiti editorial edges, cyber city/moon narrative, strong material silhouettes, readable UI layered above cinematic art.

brandSeparation.moonframe: generic reusable library brand with one optional master mark
brandSeparation.moonwitness: product/customer identity, crown, names, fictional characters, copy, project cards, sacred terms and story-specific symbols belong only to Moonwitness consumer data/assets
brandSeparation.editionMarks: stylistic skin signatures are not 15 independent company logos
brandSeparation.icons: stable accessible semantic glyph across all skins

paletteGuidance.role: Non-binding artwork direction; semantic tokens retain palette ownership
rules: neon never only signal for status
allow skin palette differences and separate light/dark
ensure text contrast on actual artwork overlays not just tokens
high saturation concentrated in accents rather than all body UI

layers: L4 interactive controls and readable type
referenceStylePolicy.responsive: At 360px reorder layout meaningfully; do not shrink screenshot or crop form/navigation
referenceStylePolicy.typography: Display brush hand-painted aesthetic must use real text or licensed lettering; never bake required labels/buttons into artwork
referenceStylePolicy.assetDelivery: PNG/WebP/AVIF are derived previews when justified, SVG is canonical for simple geometric vector, artwork may be raster if layered complexity justified
referenceStylePolicy.safety: No borrowed brand marks, photographs, artist likeness, copyrighted lyrics, or unreviewed licenses in distributable pack
referenceStylePolicy.a11y: alt text policy, decorative aria-hidden, focus visible, reduced motion/forced colors, readable body copy, no color-only states
referenceStylePolicy.performance: Reserve image dimensions, break hero into optimized art layers, budget source/outputs with measured baseline, lazy-load only noncritical imagery
